Career highlights

What sets me apart

Award-winning performance

Recognized by colleagues across multiple teams — including Application Operations and Database — who independently nominated outstanding contributions through GM's formal Recognition Program, resulting in over $7,000 in awards. A testament to the cross-functional trust and reputation built through years of reliable, customer-first service.

Security clearance

Held active security clearance to support GM Defense and OnStar Emergency Services applications — selected as one of a limited group of administrators entrusted with access to sensitive, mission-critical infrastructure.

100% SLA record

Led a team that resolved 100% of production and non-production incidents within defined SLAs across a complex, global environment. Served as the first line of triage — thoroughly gathering issue details and context upfront before strategically assigning service requests to the right team members, reducing back-and-forth and enabling faster, more effective resolutions.

Mentorship & leadership

Guided the onboarding and offboarding of new hires and contractors, ensuring each individual was fully versed in GM's procedures, escalation protocols, and team standards from day one. Maintained living technical documentation to keep processes current and accessible, and hosted regular knowledge-sharing sessions to sharpen the team's troubleshooting skills and keep pace with emerging issues.

Galileo to ServiceNow Transition

Recognizing an opportunity to dramatically improve the customer experience, I partnered with a ServiceNow developer to consolidate seven separate Galileo service offerings — all of which I personally owned — into a single, unified ServiceNow request. The result was a significantly simpler, faster, and more intuitive process for customers, while eliminating redundancy and reducing overhead across the support workflow.

Automation & toil elimination

Proactively identified repetitive manual processes and partnered with the SRE team to develop Ansible playbooks that automated software installations, NAS share mounting, and SSL certificate renewals — reducing multi-step tasks to a single button press. Further extended this effort by integrating an SSL certificate renewal cookbook directly into the OS patching CHEF recipe, automatically renewing certificates on supported Middleware servers during every patch cycle — dramatically reducing the manual workload.

Key projects

Work that made a difference

Mass VM migration — VMware to Red Hat OpenShift

Infrastructure

Partnered with the Virtualization team to migrate 36,000+ virtual machines from VMware to Red Hat OpenShift, serving as a key point of accountability for validating successful VM recovery on the OpenShift platform. Actively supported migrations across both test and critical production environments — including weekend production migration windows — diagnosing and resolving issues in real time to ensure continuity of critical workloads and minimize disruption across GM's enterprise infrastructure.

6,000+ server in-place upgrade program

Operations

Formed and led a cross-functional team to execute in-place operating system upgrades across 6,000+ Ubuntu and SLES servers, coordinating patching schedules and downtime windows while adhering to GM's strict security standards. Additionally owned OS patching across all Linux distributions — including RHEL, Ubuntu, OEL, and SLES — leveraging CHEF Automate to deploy patches consistently at scale. Served as the primary escalation point for patching failures, diagnosing and resolving issues to ensure every release cycle completed successfully and on schedule.

SSL certificate lifecycle management

Security

Modernized the tracking of 6,000+ SSL certificates across intranet and extranet applications in both test and production environments. What was once a manual, error-prone process managed through spreadsheets was transformed by designing and building a custom Grafana dashboard that automatically monitored certificate expiration dates and triggered alerts at the 60-day threshold. This proactive approach ensured no certificate went unnoticed, eliminated the risk of unexpected expirations, and prevented costly unplanned downtime across GM's enterprise applications.

Batch Scheduling Migration — Autosys to Tidal

Migration

Led a team responsible for decommissioning the legacy Autosys batch scheduling platform and migrating to Tidal across 50,000 virtual machines enterprise-wide. Leveraged CHEF Automate to orchestrate the uninstallation of Autosys and the clean deployment of Tidal at scale, ensuring a consistent and reliable rollout across GM's entire VM estate. This initiative eliminated a deprecated toolset, modernized GM's batch scheduling infrastructure, and demonstrated the power of automation in executing large-scale migrations with precision and minimal disruption.

ServiceNow workflow consolidation

Process improvement

Merged 7 fragmented ITSM/Galileo service requests into a single unified ServiceNow workflow, streamlining customer support, reducing friction, and improving the overall service experience for internal stakeholders.

Slack Workflow & Self-Service FAQ System

Process improvement

Designed and deployed a custom Slack workflow within the team's support channel to streamline how application teams engaged with the Linux and Middleware team. The workflow surfaced a curated "most frequently asked questions" knowledge base, enabling customers to self-serve answers to common Unix and Middleware questions before escalating to the team. This deflected a significant volume of repetitive inbound requests, reduced interruptions, and freed the team to focus on higher-complexity issues — improving both response quality and overall team efficiency.
